lines.en: label christmastwo14:
scene sidechristmas1
: It’s been quite a while since we’ve done anything like this, hasn’t it?
: Probably about...365 days?
: They normally take Christmas trees down after Christmas is over.
: Then we should probably stop waiting until February to remove ours.
: We’ll get to it when we get to it.
: That we will, my kitten.
: Hey...Wakana?
: Yes, my love?
: Thanks for coming tonight...I know you don’t normally like doing things like this.
: The list of things I actively enjoy is rather short...so if I am able to make your life the slightest bit better by staring at lights with you, I will happily blind myself.
: I mean...you don’t have to go that far.
: But I would.
: There are few things in life I would not do for you, Osako.
: You’re...being surprisingly sentimental all of a sudden. It’s not like you.
: Indeed I am.
: Perhaps this is what they call “Christmas spirit?”
: It’s quite strange how simply staring at this tree compels me to say things like this to you.
: But I suppose I’m a rather compulsive woman by nature, aren’t I?
: That’s a little bit of an understatement...
: It’s not like that’s a new characteristic or anything, though. I’ve known you to be that person ever since I met you and it did nothing to keep me away.
: In fact, I kind of like that side of you sometimes. It keeps things...I don’t know, exciting?
: And other times?
: You can be honest with me.
: Hold nothing back for my sake.
: Then...
: Other times, it’s terrifying.
: Like, right now, everything is great. But sometimes, it feels like you’re not even living in the same world as me.
: And you’ll do these things that I know you wouldn’t choose to do if the choice was fully yours. Like...with what happened on the beach.
: I apologize again for that.
: You’ve apologized probably a hundred times by now....and I’ve accepted every single one of them.
: But that doesn’t stop me from worrying about something like that happening again in the future.
: That’s the compulsive behavior I’m really worried about. I don’t mind the small stuff like...spending too much money on clothes or...inviting your coworker over to make weird, jello soup.
: Perhaps you could chain me up to prevent those compulsions from showing up ever again? It might be fun experiencing how you feel all the time.
: Not right now, please.
: I’m sorry for the 101st time. But before you can accept this one as well, please let me say something.
: You can say whatever you want. We have the entire night to ourselves.
: And I’d like to have many more.
: That’s all I wanted to say, really. Just in a lot more words than that.
: Despite how displeased I am with the lights and sounds and crowds of people, I would not trade a moment like this for the world. And that is because you are here with me.
: I want there to be many more Christmases after this one.
: I want to hate these lights and sounds and crowds of people so much more.
: And even if I make mistakes, the same way any other human does, I do not want them to sabotage this perpetual cycle of recycled holidays and excuses to walk beside you.
: Your last mistake almost killed you, Wakana.
: And I know that’s not what you were trying to do, but it’s what happened.
: What if I didn’t come back when I did?
: What if I walked around for even, like...half an hour longer? Who knows if we’d even be standing here right now?
: That thought is precisely why I did what I did, Osako.
: In my eyes, as clouded as they were at the time, I felt as if I was going to die if I didn’t do something.
: Obviously, that was not the correct decision in hindsight, but people can not be expected to think rationally when faced with fear.
: Do you at least understand why I’ve been so...neurotic lately, then?
: I believe the word you are searching for is “clingy,” my kitten. And yes, I do.
: I’m sorry for that, by the way. I just keep thinking that if I don’t make sure you’re okay every few minutes that you’ll...yeah.
: It seems I have some work to do if you are to ever trust me again.
: It’s not a trust thing, it’s...ugh. I don’t know what it is.
: I really wish I was as good with words as you are sometimes.
: And I sometimes wish that I knew how to end a human’s life by tapping the correct pressure point.
: Besides, I do not mind your clinginess at all. I find it rather endearing, actually.
: Why else would I have not complained about it even once since college?
: I don’t know, it’s...
: I just...wish I could protect you a little better.
: I just don’t really know how to do that when I’m supposed to be protecting you from yourself.
: You are not supposed to be doing anything, my love.
: This is a battle I must fight on my own. All you need to do is be there.
: What if I’m not, though? Like...what if I’m at work? This is already getting to me. I’ve barely been able to focus at all lately.
: I know.
: It must be hard.
: But it’s my fault you’re feeling this way. So it’s also my duty to make sure it does not continue to happen.
: Additionally, I was not implying that you need to physically “be there.” It was more of a “Have faith in me and I will persist,” sort of thing.
: That somehow sounds even harder.
: It’s a challenge we will face together, then.
: Just as staring at this ridiculous fucking tree has been a challenge for me.
: You really hate it that much?
: Why must it be so bright? And how did this strange, cultural tradition of covering a tree in lights even come to be? What significance do the lights even have? How does this relate to religion?
: I think Christmas has kind of graduated being past a religious holiday for most of the cultures who actually celebrate it.
: Nonsense. Our tree is much better. And lasts two months longer as well.
: You only like our tree more because I let you cover it in lace.
: The only thing you will not let me cover in lace is you.
: You know I’m not feminine enough to pull off the stuff you wear, Wakana. I’d just...feel like shit if I were to try.
: Oh well. It will do us no good simply standing around and discussing the things I would like to make you wear should you decide to catch up on confidence one day.
: There are many more trees to see- and many more chances for me to remind you how happy I am to be both alive and by your side tonight.
: Just try not to get lost, okay? I’m worrying enough as-is. I don’t want to have to deal with trying to find you in a crowd as well.
: Yes, because I do not stand out enough with my appearance. I can see how easy it would be for you to lose sight of me.
: You know what I mean...
scene black
scene sidechristmas2
: I suppose that since you’re so worried about losing me, I’ll just have to hang on to you to make sure I don’t get lost.
: Fine by me. Not like I’m going to complain about the prettiest girl here holding onto my arm.
: Don’t worry. I’m sure to make up for our quota of “things to complain about” for the rest of the night.
: Like that strange costume that man is wearing. What is that?
: That would be Santa Claus, babe.
: Well he looks absolutely ridiculous and I have no idea why people are willingly bringing their children to him.
scene sidechristmas3
: Oh, Wakana. Do you need to take a break or anything?
: We’ve been walking for a while now and I didn’t see you take any of your meds before we left home.
: I’m fine for now, my kitten. I feel nothing at all.
: Perhaps it’s because I have such a strong arm supporting me?
scene sidechristmas4
: Y-Yeah...maybe that’s it...
: If you need to stop, though, let me know. There are plenty of places to sit around here and...like I said...we’ve got the whole night...
: And many more after it.
: Merry Christmas, Osako.
: Merry Christmas...Wakana...
scene black
: Not every circular, ramen related item contains bumps and grooves, though.
: And to discover that, you need not look any further than the container that holds the chashu.
: Bowls come in all different colors and sizes, but they are unified in the fact that they are all circular.
: Wait, Tsunecchi. My family had bowls that were kinda rectangular and-
: Heresy, Green Onion. Bowls are circular.
: Your mana’s all tapped out and you can't play any more interrupts this turn. Proceed, Kendo Princess.
: Thank you, Emerald Guardian.
scene sidechristmas5
: As I was saying, sometimes the bumps and grooves of chashu become less noticeable when you stop focusing on that one aspect and look at the bowl instead. Or, in this case, the big picture.
: Oh, is that what you were saying? I was having a hard time following.
: Silence please, affluent woman.
: Sometimes, the troubles and imperfections of life itself are harder to spot than they would be with seared pork.
: You could have a beautiful looking bowl that seems immaculate to the untrained eye when filled with ramen-
: But underneath the broth could be cracks- splintering out as if they were a spiderweb.
: And all there is to do is keep refilling it in hopes that the cracks do not become too much to bear.
: Kaori...can you stop annoying customers and help me out for a second? I’ve got no fuckin’ idea where the corkscrew is and we’ve got a table in the back looking for a bottle of wine.
: No, no, no! You’re all wrong! That’s not the best way to rub a cock at all!
: Listen here, temporary bartender girl. I’m about to teach you a trick that will drive your boyfriend wild.
: First, straighten out your palm and-
: Wait! I am not talking about the human cock! I am talking about the chicken cock! I have learned the difference recently!
scene sidechristmas6
: The...
: Wait, is that even legal? Am I allowed to talk about this?
: Uhh...I’m gonna hope this is just another misunderstanding and ask you again for a little help, please?
: Not much time to fuck around tonight, unfortunately. Whether it be with...chicken or human.
scene sidechristmas7
: The swirly metal fermented grape blood opener can be found inside the moving wooden rectangle closest to the back of your head, Aunt Yukiburger!
: The...swirly metal...grape blood...rectangle...
: Okay. Got it. I’ll just-
: Wait, if you knew what I was talking about when I asked for the corkscrew, why’d you call it that weird shit? Use the right words for shit if you know ‘em, Kaori. You’re gonna confuse somebody.
: Girl you’re servin’ already looks like she’s havin’ an existential crisis.
: Should I be stocking up on chicken porn? Is that really what people are into nowadays?
scene sidechristmas8
: I can’t believe it! Haru-chan! People are actually in my bar!
: People are spending money at my bar! They are talking to each other at my bar!
: Yup. Those are the things you’re supposed to do at a bar.
scene sidechristmas9
: Hey! Just because you’re a successful business owner doesn’t mean you should be acting like this isn’t a big deal for me.
: Pretty soon, I’m going to be joining both you and Maki in the list of people we know who are actually doing pretty well for themselves.
: I just have to figure out how to bring people in on, like...not holidays anymore and I’ll be set.
scene sidechristmas10
: Well, all things considered, things have been pretty great tonight.
: And the bar looks awesome, too.
: Well, you did help set the place up, so I can’t take all of the credit for that.
scene sidechristmas11
: Uhh...about that...
: I...didn’t really have any idea that...anything like that was going to happen today, so...
: Well, it’s not like I was really planning on it?
: If anything did happen, I figured you were just going to wait downstairs...
: Yeah, well...you kind of egged me on, so...
: Yeah...I didn’t really think about what I was saying until after the fact...but...uhh...
scene sidechristmas12
: I’m sorry!
scene sidechristmas13
: I said a lot worse stuff than you, so let me apologize first.
: It’s true that I got pissed off by all of the teasing when my husband’s been gone for so long...but I guess I kind of forgot that yours was too.
: You’re just always so all over Sensei that I forget we’re one and the same sometimes.
: So...that kinda fueled some of the stuff I said while things were happening and...it got a little too out of control.
scene sidechristmas14
: Are you, like...into that kind of stuff, Haruka?
: The...shaming and...whatnot?
: Because it seemed like it was more than just anger or jealousy. It seemed like you were actually...enjoying it.
: I guess that...makes it a lot worse, huh?
scene sidechristmas15
: I mean...not really?...
: Like, it’s one thing if you were saying all of that stuff just to hurt me, but...if it was just so you could have a little more fun...we can just...forget it ever happened.
: That’s fine. I’m sorry again. I said some really fucked up shit that sounded hot at the time, but...fuck, I felt so bad when I went home that I actually cried.
scene sidechristmas16
: Well at least you didn’t cry while there was a penis inside of you.
: Hahah...hah...yeah...
scene sidechristmas17
: That was...certainly an experience, though.
: I had no idea that my first threesome would be so...vulgar and hurtful.
: Did that like, even really count as a threesome, though? Because I was kind of just there watching. I wasn’t actually involved.
: I think it counts. Even if you just watched, you definitely...uhh...participated? Like, it would have been a completely different experience without you.
: I guess so.
scene sidechristmas18
: Definitely an interesting way to start Christmas, though.
: Can’t say I expected to watch my best friend get railed like an hour after helping her choose which color of tinsel to use.
: And I can’t say I expected mine to enjoy it so much.
: Also, did I sound weird? And don’t say you didn’t hear it this time since you were literally right there.
: I don’t remember. I was too busy being hurtful and perverted.
: Ugh. Please pay more attention next time because I really need to know and I don’t want to record myself.
: You know, I really didn’t expect there to be a next time.
: Me neither, but...we’re mature adults. I think we can do it again without all of the...meanness next time.
: So, uhh...the bar.
scene sidechristmas19
: Right! The bar!
: It looks so good. And we’ve got three whole employees working tonight.
: I wish Sana could have been here as well, but her Christmas party just had to be on like, the single least convenient day of all time.
: You mean...Christmas?
: Shut up.
scene sidechristmas20
: Wait, Kaori...
: Yes, Aunt Yukiburger? Do you need help finding another shiny item in this labyrinth of intoxicated women?
: No, it’s just...
: I could be completely misremembering but like, ain’t it your birthday today?
scene sidechristmas21
: But I have so many memories of other days! How could I have been born today?!
: No, it means like...you were born on a different “today” in the past.
: I am from the past?!
: I mean...we kinda all are.
scene sidechristmas22
: Kaori, is that true? Is it really your birthday today?
: I still do not understand the concept of this “day of birthing,” but if Aunt Yukiburger, who is also from the past, knows the past-version of me...it might be true!
: Will something bad happen as a result of this? Has my time here finally come to an end?
: I must say goodbye to John!
: Is John your chicken boyfriend?
: Just her chicken. And he’s fucking huge, too. You should see that thing.
scene sidechristmas23
: Heh. Huge cock.
: Haru-chan, you didn’t see any birthday decorations in the storage room, did you?
: Hm? I might have seen like, a banner or something. But are you really sure you want to put something like that up while we already have all of the Christmas decorations out?
scene sidechristmas24
: Kaori, are you going straight home after we close tonight?
: Sleeping at work is forbidden, so I normally go home at the end of the day.
: Stay later tonight. After all of the customers leave, we’ll throw a little birthday party for you.
: Ooooh, fun! I haven’t pulled an all-nighter in years. What better reason to break that streak than for a temporary bartender’s birthday party?
scene sidechristmas25
: A party? For me? Just because I was born?
: Is that really a cause for celebration?
: Of course it is! Be happy you’re alive!
: I feel shitty for not gettin’ you somethin’ now. Can’t believe I forgot.
: Not a big fan of stayin’ awake through the night, but I’ll make an exception for you since we’re related and shit.
: I do not understand the customs that typically accompany human birth-parties, but since I am the subject of the tradition this time, I will remain inside and do as you instruct.
: Woo-hoo! It’s settled, then! Haruka, go get the banner!
: Sara, I think you’re forgetting that I don’t actually work here. I’m a customer right now.
: Maki, banner!
: Are you just going to ask everyone who doesn’t work here?
scene black
: You there! What’s your name?
: Me?
: Yes! Who are you?
: Matthew.
: Take this key, open that door over there, pull out the birthday banner, and your next drink is on me.
: Oh. Uhh...okay. I’m on it.
: Wonderful! Thanks, Matthew.
